title: Separate DSH invariant-test bootstrap failure from feature regression
content: DSH tool-workflow tests can fail before test logic because scripts/test-invariants.ts observes FiberState as undefined in the current dirty checkout; retain the exact bootstrap stack and classify it separately from the workflow feature under test.

title: Retain typed diagnostics when fan-out maps child failures to null
content: Fan-out combinators may intentionally map ordinary child failures to null, but the enclosing result must retain typed per-child diagnostics or governance callers cannot establish retry eligibility without inventing evidence.
